annotations.title: Close program work items as fixed

description: Batch-close unique, non-terminal work items already fixed outside AnyForge. Call action=preview with closures, present the linked impact, then call action=execute with only proposalToken. Each closure needs workItemId and closedReason; closedAsFixedByWorkItemId is optional.

closures.description: Required for preview; maximum 50 unique items.

proposalToken.description: Required for execute; returned by preview.
